## Operational question

Does one snapshot support a coherent ring-like organisation, and does that conclusion depend on representing the agents by position, interaction or density?

## Observed and constructed objects

The synthetic observations are agent positions and weighted pairwise interactions at one time. From them we construct a position point cloud, an interaction graph or clique complex, and a density field on a fixed grid.

## Topological constructions

- Rips persistence of positions over $\mathbb F_2$ in $H_0,H_1$;
- weighted graph persistence, with clique filling audited explicitly;
- cubical sublevel persistence of low-density or high-density regions after choosing filtration direction.

## Baselines and sensitivity

Compare with radial spread, graph cycle rank and thresholded connected components. Repeat after subsampling agents, changing the distance metric, toggling clique filling and changing field bandwidth.

## Interpretation boundary

A persistent loop belongs to the selected representation. It may describe spatial arrangement, interaction structure or a density-derived region. These claims are not interchangeable, and this synthetic page reports no empirical swarm result.
